20:00 │ A CONTINUACIÓN: College Football
The No. 7 Miami Hurricanes (9-1) host the Virginia Tech Hokies (6-4) for an NCAA football game at Hard Rock Stadium. Virginia Tech aims to break a two-game skid behind Ethan Grunkemeyer, while Miami enters after a 36-25 win against Duke.
